alerts.title: Iran war live: Iranian media reports ‘massive explosions’ in Hormuz Strait
alerts.why: Explosions in the Strait of Hormuz threaten a critical global oil chokepoint, instantly triggering massive supply disruption fears.

alerts.title: Oil Prices and Tanker Rates Rise After Latest Iranian Attacks in Mideast
alerts.why: Iranian attacks on tankers in the Arabian Gulf threaten key supply chokepoints, driving a sharp risk premium into crude and safe-haven gold.
